So your solution would be to use ".ais-hierarchical-menu--list .ais-hierarchical-menu--list" style then remove the style with selectors like ".ais-hierarchical-menu--list .ais-hierarchical-menu--list .ais-hierarchical-menu--list"?

> You would rarely have more than three levels, and this issue was about distinguishing between first level and others.

In most cases yes. But don't you think it would feel to you as an API #fail to have to do like you proposed?
